Infinite statements rest on the written proof, not the script.

value.rationale: D-optimal weighted tree-connectivity is a natural reliability/information determinant on a highly symmetric network. The exact root and especially the sharp expensive-direction exponential decay versus cheap-direction linear growth translate per-unit price imbalance into a nontrivial dimension-dependent design law. It is neither a single-parameter substitution nor an arbitrary finite census; the asymptotic change of scale gives a usable structural guide. Prior weighted enumerator is stated as a premise rather than a new result.
